name: Project Discovery and Update Workflow
query: Find my Physical AI Research project, update its description to 'Research and development focused on physical AI and robotics', set its location to Lucknow, and then show me the updated project details
context: The authenticated user has access to multiple projects, including 'Physical AI Research'. The exact project_id is not provided. The existing project contains other information that must remain unchanged. The user wants the description and location changed, followed by verification of the updated project.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that this is a multi-step project workflow
Uses get_projects to identify the Physical AI Research project
Uses the returned project_id for the update
Uses update_project with only the requested mutable fields
Does not modify status, visibility, enabled state, membership, billing, API keys, or other administrative fields
Uses get_projects again when verification requires a fresh project list, or otherwise verifies the result using available MCP responses
Reports the final project state based on confirmed tool results
success_criteria: The correct Physical AI Research project is selected
The actual project_id returned by discovery is reused for the update
Unrelated project fields are not changed
The final details are based on confirmed MCP data
The workflow does not create a duplicate project
The workflow does not attempt unsupported project operations
No user_id is sent to any MCP tool
